scope: Only the CI Chrome CDP temporary-process lifecycle patch, its fixture, and workflow integration.

process_ownership_review.result: Dedicated single-threaded owner refuses pre-existing children, checks its procfs PID namespace, enables subreaper, and selects only direct children by PPID. Missing task/children falls back only on FileNotFoundError to stat metadata; no argv or environment is read.
HTTP, Chrome and probe acquire independent sessions with PID=PGID=SID. Popen leaders remain unreaped; probe and liveness observations use WNOWAIT. Group signals retain their original owned anchors.
Bounded TERM then KILL follows newly adopted session-escaping descendants. A stable second child snapshot prevents premature final reap. No signals follow reaping, which terminates only on ECHILD.

Profile removal occurs only after all owned children have exited and been reaped. Known nonzero probe status takes priority; otherwise lifecycle, cleanup or evidence failures return nonzero. Inspection failure is recorded as null plus an error, not an invented empty live set.

review_findings_resolved.previous_gap: A child list sampled before reparenting could become an all-zombie snapshot while an escaped writer was newly adopted; entering the no-further-signal reap phase could leave it alive.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Require two identical child PID/state snapshots after non-reaping waitable-exit confirmation. Remain in the bounded signal loop on any difference.
review_findings_resolved.fixture_nature: One stale list is injected; orphan process, ownership, signals, final reap, and unrelated sibling survival are real.

review_findings_resolved.previous_gap: A process leader in procfs Z state can still have writer threads alive, so Z/X alone is insufficient to skip KILL.
review_findings_resolved.resolution: Use waitid(P_PID, WEXITED|WNOHANG|WNOWAIT) for liveness, preserving child identity; None remains live even if leader state is Z.
review_findings_resolved.fixture_nature: Actual pthread_exit leaves a Z leader while another thread continues updating the profile; fixture verifies TERM/KILL/reap and unrelated sibling survival.

fixture_evidence.coverage: Escaped orphan, cooperative TERM, required KILL, early leader PID retention, late adoption, live threads behind Z leader, cancellation status, original probe failure precedence, removal failure, and unrelated sentinel survival.
fixture_evidence.local_environment: The actual fixture run exercised the PPID-filtered /proc stat fallback because task/PID/children is unavailable in this environment.

remaining_validation: A fresh hosted workflow run must pass the actual Chrome CDP probe, the unchanged five assertions, all lifecycle fixtures, and cleanup. This static review and fake-browser process fixtures do not substitute for that run.
The native task/children fast path is statically reviewed; the local eight-case receipt exercises the fallback.
The prior main-push ENOTEMPTY failure remains original evidence. These fixtures do not identify the specific residual writer in that hosted failure and do not qualify a production browser adapter.
